# MiniWebtool

> > MiniWebtool provides free online calculators, converters, and tools spanning health, finance, unit conversion, number systems, and image editing.

MiniWebtool offers specialized calculators using established formulas (Mifflin-St Jeor, Harris-Benedict, ACC/AHA Pooled Cohort Equations) and conversion tools with step-by-step solutions. The platform serves users needing quick calculations for medical assessments (BMR, ASCVD risk), financial planning (compound interest, estate tax), unit conversions (acres to square feet, cups to liters), and digital utilities (decimal to BCD, hex to octal).

## Key Topics

- BMR (Basal Metabolic Rate)
- TDEE (Total Daily Energy Expenditure)
- ASCVD (Atherosclerotic Cardiovascular Disease)
- ACC/AHA Pooled Cohort Equations
- Mifflin-St Jeor formula
- Harris-Benedict equation
- Financial calculators
- Unit conversion tools
- Step-by-step solutions
- Binary-Coded Decimal (BCD)
- Blood sugar conversion (mg/dL to mmol/L)
- RER (Resting Energy Requirement)
- Compound interest
- Ohm's Law
- Medical risk calculators

## Health & Medical Calculators

- [Heart Disease Risk Calculator - 10-Year ASCVD Risk Estimator (ACC/AHA Pooled Cohort Equations)](https://miniwebtool.com/heart-disease-risk-calculator): 10-year ASCVD risk calculator using ACC/AHA Pooled Cohort Equations
- [BMR Calculator - Calculate Your Basal Metabolic Rate (Mifflin-St Jeor & Harris-Benedict)](https://miniwebtool.com/bmr-calculator): Calculate BMR & TDEE using Mifflin-St Jeor & Harris-Benedict formulas
- [Ideal Weight Calculator - How Much Should I Weigh for My Height?](https://miniwebtool.com/how-much-should-i-weigh): Calculate ideal weight using 5 formulas: Devine, Robinson, Miller & more
- [Blood Sugar Converter - mg/dL to mmol/L Calculator with Diabetes Ranges](https://miniwebtool.com/blood-sugar-converter): Convert blood sugar between mg/dL & mmol/L with diabetes ranges
- [Corrected Sodium Calculator - Hyperglycemia Sodium Correction with Clinical Interpretation](https://miniwebtool.com/corrected-sodium-calculator): Correct sodium for hyperglycemia using Katz & Hillier formulas
- [Cat Calorie Calculator | Daily Calorie Needs (RER & MER) for Cats](https://miniwebtool.com/cat-calorie-calculator): Calculate cat's daily calories using RER formula & life-stage multipliers
- [Cost of Smoking Calculator - See How Much Smoking Really Costs You](https://miniwebtool.com/cost-of-smoking-calculator): Calculate lifetime smoking costs with investment & health recovery data
